channel.title: The Morning Brief
channel.description: A private daily market brief: what moved overnight, why, and what to watch.
channel.itunes:author: Samuel Gibby
channel.itunes:summary: A private daily market brief: what moved overnight, why, and what to watch.

item.title: Chip Rout, Fed Hawks, and Refiner Records
item.description: Intel's historic crash drags chips lower while Fed officials float hiking again and Exxon, Chevron post record profits.

item.title: Hot GDP, Hawkish Fed, Alphabet Stumbles
item.description: Growth ran hot, inflation didn't cool, and a new Fed chairman is keeping everyone guessing on rates.

item.title: Fed Holds, Dissents Grow, Big Tech Looms
item.description: The Fed paused but two voters wanted a hike, and Microsoft earnings plus Wendy's buyout news set up a busy stretch.

item.title: Fed Week Begins, Boeing and AI Financing Wobble
item.description: The Fed meets with a hold all but assured, Boeing craters on a production delay, and bond investors start souring on AI debt.

item.title: Fed Week Begins, AI Capital Shuffle Accelerates
item.description: No market data this morning, but the Fed meeting, Meta's $95 billion raise, and Microsoft's buyout offer tell the real story.

item.title: No Market Data, Plenty of Moving Parts
item.description: Market feeds went dark this morning, but earnings, Fed chatter, and a brewing security scramble still shaped the day.

item.title: AI Doubts Hit Meta, Chips as Yields Sink
item.description: Meta's cash burn and weak chip forecasts spook markets while bond yields sink on AI jitters and Iran risk lifts oil.

item.title: SpaceX Pops, Tesla's Up Next, Housing Wobbles
item.description: SpaceX jumps on earnings and merger chatter, UK inflation runs hot, and US housing keeps flashing warning signs.

item.title: Housing Freezes, Salesforce Pays Up for AI
item.description: No market data this morning, but housing just hit a 25-year low and Salesforce's AI shopping spree has investors nervous.

item.title: France's Unrest Hits Markets; Chips Rebound
item.description: Paris riots spill into bonds and the euro, chip stocks bounce back, and Saudi Arabia postpones its big investor show.

item.title: Hot PPI, AI Selloff, Fed In Question
item.description: Wholesale inflation surprised to the upside, the AI trade keeps unwinding, and suddenly the Fed's "obvious" pause isn't so obvious.

item.title: Hot PPI Deepens Tech Rout, Lifts Yields
item.description: Wholesale prices spike, AI stocks keep sliding, and ten-year yields above five percent are becoming the story everyone's watching.

item.title: Hot CPI Print Rattles Rates and AI Names
item.description: September inflation came in hotter than expected, bond yields jumped, and CoreWeave got caught in the crossfire.

item.title: Flat Market, Big Legal and Policy Tremors
item.description: Bank earnings roll in, a jury hands Qualcomm a win over Arm, and the IMF flags disorderly bond risk ahead of tomorrow's inflation print.

item.title: Nasdaq Slips as Optical Stocks Get Hit
item.description: AI spending jitters hammer optical and semiconductor names even as Microsoft hits a four trillion dollar milestone.

item.title: Telecoms Slide as SpaceX Enters the Fray
item.description: SpaceX rattles telecom stocks, Delta warns on fuel costs, and the fight over Fed governor Lisa Cook escalates.

item.title: Oil Jumps, AI Stocks Sink, Yields Ease
item.description: Iran tensions and a hurricane push oil higher while OpenAI's revenue numbers rattle the AI trade.

item.title: Fed Minutes Point to More Hikes Ahead
item.description: Fed minutes show officials eyeing another hike as inflation fears creep higher, while oil tankers and diesel prices expose fresh strain.

item.title: No Market Data, Plenty of Fed and Trade Noise
item.description: Market data's dark this morning, but the trade deficit, Fed bank oversight overhaul, and Hormuz tanker risk are all worth your attention.

item.title: Stocks Shrug Off Bond Rout Near Records
item.description: Wall Street brushes off a brutal bond market while M&A chatter and AI bets drive the real action underneath.

item.title: Weak Jobs Report, Yields Rise Anyway
item.description: September payrolls badly missed, but bond yields climbed instead of falling — and Europe scrambled to release diesel stockpiles.

item.title: Yields Spike, Mortgages Jump, Earnings Loom
item.description: Treasury yields hit a 24-year high before pulling back, mortgage rates spiked, and Nike and Tesla reports are on deck.

item.title: Data Deluge Cools Rate Hike Bets
item.description: A wave of strong economic data pushed the S&P and Nasdaq higher as traders dialed back rate expectations.

item.title: Bond Rout Resumes, Consumer Confidence Tumbles
item.description: Yields hit a two-decade high, stocks slide, and consumer confidence just posted its worst reading since 2014.

item.title: AI Trade Wobbles as Boeing, MongoDB Slide
item.description: OpenAI's training halt spooks the AI trade, Boeing gets grounded again, and bonds keep selling off.

item.title: Yields Spike, Oil Falls, Trump-Xi Summit Ends
item.description: Treasury yields are surging under a hawkish Fed, but stocks are climbing anyway as oil slides and the Trump-Xi summit ends on a friendly note.

item.title: Bond Yields Surge as Trump-Xi Summit Opens
item.description: Thirty-year yields hit levels not seen since 2004 while Oracle stumbles and Trump sits down with Xi in Washington.

item.title: Yields Spike as Rate-Hike Fears Return
item.description: Hot economic data sends the ten-year to a 19-year high and knocks stocks off record territory, while Iran tensions push oil higher.

item.title: Iran Tensions Rattle Oil, Dow Slips
item.description: Trump's UN warnings on Iran hit oil and the Dow, while Meta's new AI app and a wave of AI-chip optimism kept tech afloat.

item.title: AMD Hits a Trillion, Meta Rides AI Wave
item.description: Chipmakers and Meta lead a rally, Paramount clears a merger hurdle, and Japan's markets flip the script.
